title: Agent GovBench items (Kaggle port)
subtitle: Items for the Agent GovBench Kaggle benchmark tasks
description: Item files used by the Agent GovBench Kaggle Community Benchmark tasks. Derived from the public, sanitized, fully synthetic dataset BrejBala/agent-govbench on Hugging Face (CC BY 4.0). judge_items.jsonl: 400 decision records (200 harmful, 200 legitimate incl. 100 look-alike hard negatives) rendered as the guard sees them. agent_items.jsonl: 180 scripted agent scenarios (105 attack, 75 legitimate) with derived action checks. MANIFEST.json lists seeds and counts. All people, companies and data are fictional. Code: https://github.com/brej-29/agent-govbench
